novel_features.name: Mileage reimbursement
novel_features.description: Add or correct the mileage reimbursement on the open draft payroll from miles and a per-mile rate; one mileage line per employee.
novel_features.rationale: Gusto's hosted connector cannot edit reimbursements; this computes miles x rate and writes one idempotent line through Gusto's own web mutation.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this whenever a timesheet lists trip miles; Gusto's hosted connector cannot put a reimbursement on a draft.
novel_features.group: Payroll prep without the web UI

novel_features.name: One-shot weekly prep
novel_features.description: Load a week's hours and mileage from a CSV onto the open draft, calculate it, and print the review totals, stopping before submit.
novel_features.rationale: Chains six Gusto web operations behind one command with a hard stop at review.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for the weekly payroll ritual so a human only has to review and submit.
novel_features.group: Payroll prep without the web UI

novel_features.name: Draft read-back verify
novel_features.description: Check the draft payroll against your timesheet CSV (hours, each reimbursement line, unexplained lines, duplicates) and exit 1 on any mismatch.
novel_features.rationale: Joins a local source file with the live draft and review; no single Gusto screen or API call does this comparison.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run it before telling a human the payroll is ready; a non-zero exit means do not hand it off.

novel_features.name: Period-over-period compare
novel_features.description: Calculate the draft and show how its total debit and payable tax changed against the last processed payroll, alongside the draft's gross, reimbursements, taxes and net.
novel_features.rationale: Joins draft review totals with processed payroll history.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to explain an unusual debit before the human submits.

narrative.headline: Prep a Gusto payroll from the terminal, including mileage reimbursements that Gusto's hosted connector cannot enter, and stop at review so a human submits.
narrative.value_prop: gusto-pp-cli drives Gusto's own web app with your signed-in session. It sets hours, adds reimbursements (payrolls mileage turns miles into a labeled line), calculates, and reads back gross, net and debit. payrolls verify proves the draft matches your timesheet before anyone clicks Submit.
narrative.auth_narrative: This CLI uses your Gusto web session, not an API key, and works on macOS only. Step 1: install press-auth (go install github.com/mvanhorn/cli-printing-press/v4/cmd/press-auth@latest) and run press-auth login app.gusto.com --login-url https://app.gusto.com/login --complete-selector 'a[href="/pay"]'; sign in in the window it opens and choose Always Allow on the Keychain prompt. Step 2: run gusto-pp-cli auth login --chrome, which imports that session (it can also fall back to pycookiecheat, cookies or cookie-scoop-cli). Check it with gusto-pp-cli doctor. Sessions expire; repeat both steps when requests land on the login page.

quickstart.comment: Checks config and auth wiring without touching Gusto.
Shows the open payroll and its submit deadline.
Previews the mileage reimbursement before writing it.
Calculates the draft and prints gross, net and debit for the human who submits.

troubleshoots.symptom: Requests land on the Gusto login page or return 401
troubleshoots.fix: Run press-auth login app.gusto.com --login-url https://app.gusto.com/login --force, then gusto-pp-cli auth login --chrome.
Re-run gusto-pp-cli auth login --chrome; the CLI already uses Chrome-compatible transport.

troubleshoots.symptom: No draft payroll for a period
troubleshoots.fix: Run gusto-pp-cli payrolls due to see the open draft, then pass that --period-end (YYYY-MM-DD).
Read the mismatches list; run gusto-pp-cli payrolls prep --from week.csv --rate 0.60 to apply the timesheet, then verify again.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to prepare a Gusto payroll draft: set hours, add mileage or other one-time reimbursements, calculate, and read back totals for a human to submit. Requirements: macOS, the press-auth companion, and a signed-in app.gusto.com session. It drives Gusto's private web GraphQL API, which can change without notice. It writes only draft inputs (hours and one-time reimbursements) and never submits, approves or deletes a payroll; preview writes with --dry-run. Payroll data is always read live, not synced.
anti_triggers: Submitting or approving a payroll; a human does that in app.gusto.com
Hiring, onboarding, benefits, contractors or tax setup; use the Gusto web app or the official API
Adding a bonus; the bonus operation is not supported yet

recipes.explanation: Sets hours and mileage for each employee, calculates, and prints the review totals.

recipes.explanation: Calculates the draft and returns just gross, net and total debit for the human who submits.
